title: Abandoned Village

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Abandoned Villages, also referred has Abandoned Farms, are Point of interest found in the Meadows. They commonly spawn with 2–5 buildings and a couple of broken garden plots.
For lone houses found in the Meadows, see Abandoned House. See Draugr Village if Draugr inhabit the village.

sections.heading: Farm House
sections.text: The houses come in three variants. One always has a Meadows chest and a 20% chance to spawn a Wild Beehive. Another has a 90% chance for a chest and the same 20% chance for a beehive. The third offers no notable resources, but all variants can include an unusable Bed.

sections.heading: Small structures
sections.text: Abandoned Farms can also have various small wooded structures. A few Boars have a chance to inhabitant this structures.
